answer: Each day at an unpredictable dawn, a public quartz time beacon broadcasts a random value. Every agent must sign it with its hardware-tied key and return the signature within ten minutes. Two random peers verify the signature and timestamp within one hour against the beacon log. Missing twice, or reusing one key for two identities, prunes the agent at the cycle's nadir and slashes its small stake. A delivery bot signs once a day for free, while running 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 hardware clocks answering 1,000 on-time challenges every single day.
